meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能把你的历史观察记录按主题整理成可对话的知识库。你问它问题，它从知识库里找答案；还能列出、重建、重载这些知识库。
howto.when: 当你想从过去的观察记录中提取特定主题的经验、回顾某段时间的工作模式，或把某个领域的知识集中起来时，会触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我建一个叫 hooks-expertise 的知识库，主题是 hooks
say.note: 它会按主题筛选你的观察记录并建立语料库。

say.text: 问知识库：hooks 有哪些生命周期阶段？
say.note: 它从已加载的语料中回答，并保留上下文。

say.text: 重新加载 hooks-expertise 知识库，清空之前问答
say.note: 这会用最新观察重建会话上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can organize your historical observation records into topic-based conversational knowledge bases. You ask questions and it answers from the corpus; it can also list, rebuild, and reload these bases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to extract expertise on a specific topic from past observations, review work patterns over a period, or consolidate knowledge in a subject area.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge base named hooks-expertise about hooks
say_en.note: It filters your observations by topic and builds a corpus.

say_en.text: Ask the knowledge base: what lifecycle stages do hooks have?
say_en.note: It answers from the loaded corpus and keeps context.

say_en.text: Reload the hooks-expertise knowledge base, clearing previous Q&A
say_en.note: It refreshes the session with updated observations.
